newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota shares climb to record high.
newsitem.headline: Toyota shares climb to record high.

text.p: Shares in Toyota Motor Corp climbed to a record high on Monday morning, with the major auto maker a target of selective buying amid the uncertain outlook of the entire market, traders said.
As of 0044 GMT, the share price had gained 20 yen to 3,350 yen, its highest level ever. The previous high was 3,340 yen, reached on December 27, 1996.
Turnover was 1.01 million shares, the seventh-heaviest trade in the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
"With weak sentiment lingering in the market, blue-chip issues such as Toyota are the only ones that we can buy now," said a trader at a major Japanese securities house.

The Nikkei 225, the benchmark index in the Tokyo stock market, was down 49.31 points or 0.25 percent at 19,312.04 by 0054 GMT, as worries over the uncertain outlook for the Japanese economy continued to drag down the stock market.
